subject: Long overdue catch-up!
body:
Hi Nicholas,

Sorry I've been so quiet - the summer completely got away from us. We spent three weeks in Sweden at my parents' cabin, and the kids basically lived in the lake. Emil finally learned to swim properly, and Freja collected about four hundred stones that are now all over our hallway.

Since we got back it's been chaos: Lars started his new job, the kitchen tap broke, and I'm still unpacking boxes from the holiday. How was your summer? Did you make it to the coast in the end? Mia mentioned something about a boat trip to Emil, and he's been begging for one ever since.

Also - have you tried the new bakery on Kirchplatz? Their cinnamon buns are dangerously good.

Oh, and before I forget: Emil turns 8 on the 10th and we're having a little party at ours on Saturday 10 October, 14:00-17:00. Mia is very welcome! Could you let me know by Wednesday whether she can come, so I can plan the cake and the treasure hunt?

Hugs,
Kate
label: actionable
rationale: A chatty catch-up that hides an invitation for the owner's child to a party on 10 October, with an RSVP needed by Wednesday.
adj_note: RSVP by Wednesday whether Mia attends Emil's party Sat 10 Oct 14:00-17:00.
